# Introduction {.unnumbered}

This document provides the technical documentation required by Article 31 and Annex VII of Regulation (EU) 2024/2847 (the Cyber Resilience Act) for products with digital elements placed on the EU market.

**Product:** {{< meta product.name >}}  
**Manufacturer:** {{< meta manufacturer.name >}}  
**Document Version:** {{< meta version >}}  
**Product Category:** {{< meta product.category >}}

## Purpose and Scope

This technical documentation demonstrates compliance with the essential cybersecurity requirements set out in Annex I of the CRA. It accompanies the EU Declaration of Conformity and provides evidence that the product meets the applicable requirements for its category.

## Document Structure

This document follows the structure specified in CRA Annex VII:

1. **Product Description** - General description and intended use
2. **Design and Development** - Architecture, components, and security design
3. **Cybersecurity Risk Assessment** - Identified risks and mitigation measures
4. **Applied Standards** - Harmonised standards and common specifications
5. **EU Declaration of Conformity** - Formal declaration per Annex V
6. **Software Bill of Materials (SBOM)** - Component inventory per Annex I Part II(1)

## Conformity Assessment Route

**Route:** {{< meta conformity.route >}}

This product has been assessed using the conformity assessment route specified in CRA Article 47.
